name: Ocean
description: No islands, no cover. Just open water and whoever aims better.

keyAreas.name: Center
keyAreas.notes: The only real feature on this map is positioning itself. Control of the center dictates the whole match.

keyAreas.name: Either flank
keyAreas.notes: Completely open. Pushing a flank here means committing in full view of the enemy team.

keyAreas.name: Everywhere else
keyAreas.notes: No cover anywhere. Positioning and angling matter more here than on any other map.

strategyNotes: Destroyers are exposed early. There's no cover to approach the enemy unseen.
Battleships should stick together and cross-fire rather than push alone. There's nowhere to hide from a focused broadside.
Cruisers do better held back, using range and smoke instead of trying to flank.
